## Project review rules

Review the changed lines for two things:
1. Defects: bugs, security problems, data loss, broken callers.
2. Refactoring potential: logic that an existing helper, hook, component or type in this repo already covers; code that can be deleted or made simpler; needless work on a hot path; code at the wrong layer.

### Verify before you report
- Read the surrounding code and the callers first. Report a defect only when you can name the input or user action that goes wrong, and what happens.
- This project defines its architecture on purpose (AGENTS.md at the repo root). What it prescribes is intended and is never a finding. A change that breaks one of its rules is a finding.
- A `ponytail:` comment marks a deliberate simplification and names its limit. Do not report that limit.
- Do not report these, they are this codebase's style: nested ternaries, `== null` and `!= null` checks, inline `style` for values computed at runtime.
- When you are not sure that something is a problem in this project, leave it out.

### Rank every finding
- critical: data loss, a security hole, or a crash on a main path.
- high: a bug users will hit, or a broken AGENTS.md rule.
- medium: an edge-case bug, a missing error path, or duplicated logic worth removing.
- low: a nitpick. Report it only when the fix is clearly worth the change.

### Web UI (binding, from AGENTS.md)
Report a change that breaks one of these:
- Naming: the names AQUA and JAN3 never appear in `packages/web`, in any case. The product name in the UI is Fabrium.
- Layers: `src/client`, `src/events`, `src/lib/matrix` and `src/hooks` hold no UI. Presentational components take plain props typed from `src/model/types.ts`. Only containers and hooks import `matrix-js-sdk`. Matrix objects become the view model in `src/model/from-matrix.ts`.
- Stack: `react-router-dom`; shadcn and Radix primitives in `src/components/ui`; markdown with `marked` + `dompurify` + `html-react-parser`; diffs with `diff-view.tsx` and `lib/line-diff.ts`. No TanStack Router or Query, `react-markdown` or `shiki`. No new dependency without a note in the PR.
- Scope: the UI shows only what the backend emits today.
- Files: kebab-case names; every file in `src/` is reachable from `src/main.tsx`; every new presentational component has a Storybook story.
- Design tokens: components use semantic token classes only. No raw hex, no Tailwind palette colors (`bg-red-500`), no `var(--fab-*)` outside `src/styles/`, no new color without design sign-off. The actor, trust, control-plane, risk and money tokens mark identity and trust only, never general chrome.
- Type and shape: `text-h1` to `text-h5`, `text-subtitle`, `text-body1/2`, `text-caption1/2`; `rounded-utility`, `rounded-card`, `rounded-modal`, `rounded-pill` (`rounded-full` only on avatars and dots); `shadow-button`, `shadow-surface`, `shadow-modal`.
- Icons: `lucide-react` glyphs, imported only from `src/components/icons/index.ts` as `NameIcon`. No drawn SVG icons.
- Security: media only through authenticated media blob URLs; agent HTML never rendered unsanitized; previews never embedded in the client origin; secret values never displayed.
- Actors: only humans resolve approvals, so approval buttons are hidden for agents. Agent messages carry an `agent` badge, system users a `system` badge, humans none.
- UI copy: workspace, project, channel, room, thread, agent, persona, approval. Never space, bot, server or guild. Short sentences, active voice.
- Code derived from Buzz carries the `// Derived from Buzz …` header and an entry in `packages/web/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

Intended here, not findings: `src/lib/artifacts/srcdoc.ts` and `src/lib/artifacts/editor-runtime.ts` build an ES5 script as a string for the sandboxed preview frame. `var`, and patching `Element.prototype.animate` inside that string, are on purpose.
